title: 第3章 我能跟您合张影吗？-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “叫什么名字？”或许是一时无聊，沈珩主动攀谈了起来，声音不大，带着点随意。

    “额，韩小汐。”韩小汐回神，老老实实回答，又觉得太干巴，补了一句，“潮汐的汐。”

    沈珩点了点头，没再多言。

    安静了几秒，他又开口，“大学生？”

    “嗯，大一。”

    “什么专业？”

    “美术。”

    沈珩微微扬眉，似乎有点意外，但没说什么，只是“嗯”了一声。

    一问一答间，韩小汐也放松了不少，看着男人胳膊上的血痕，再次道歉，“沈老师，实在是对不起，我真的不是故意伤到你。”

    听说艺人的皮相就是资本，金贵着呢！

    她一个穷学生可赔不起。

    “都说没事了，别放在心上。”沈珩轻笑，开起了无伤大雅的玩笑，“不过，你似乎该修剪指甲了。”

    韩小汐愣怔，举起了自己，不、原主的小爪子，看着有些熟悉，她自己也是这样的。

    右手的小拇指稍微留长了些，是一般美术生都有的习惯，画素描或者速写时方便支撑走线。

    估计就是这个指甲误伤了影帝。

    罪过啊！

    沈珩看着面前小女生傻气的动作，唇角的弧度大了些，“你好好休息，不用管我，或者，当我不存在。”

    韩小汐急急忙忙点头，这位是真的半点派头都没有，特别好相处。

    帅哥当前，她大着胆子请求，“沈老师，我能跟您合张影吗？”

    上辈子也有过一次合照，是他到她所在的子公司视察时，跟全体员工的大合照。

    他在C位，她在犄角旮旯。

    “当然可以。”沈珩放下了交叠的大长腿，唇角始终挂着浅浅的微笑，没有半分不耐烦，“你过来还是我过去？”

    “我过来，您坐着就行！”韩小汐一时激动，掀了被子就下床，还顺手捞过了床上的手机。

    看到手里的小手机，她才猛然想起来，这款手机没有摄像头。

    压根拍不了照片……

    “那个……沈老师，还是算了吧。”她尴尬地红了脸。

    “没事，过来吧，用我的手机。”男人很绅士地往沙发一旁靠了靠，给她让出了大半的位置。

    还从口袋里掏出了先前那款看着就高级的翻盖商务手机。

    韩小汐点头如捣蒜，连忙汲着拖鞋跑了过来，有些拘谨地坐在男人身边。

    看到男人手机屏幕里显现出两人此刻的样子，韩小汐整个人都呆住了。
    第(1/3)页

"What's your name?" Perhaps out of boredom, Shen Heng took the initiative to chat, his voice was low and a little casual.

"Uh, Han Xiaoxi." Han Xiaoxi came back to her senses and answered honestly, but then felt it was too dry, so she added, "The tide is the tide."

Shen Heng nodded and said no more.

After being quiet for a few seconds, he spoke again, "College student?"

"Well, freshman year."

"What major?"

"Art."

Shen Heng raised his eyebrows slightly, seeming a little surprised, but didn't say anything, just said "hmm".

During the question and answer, Han Xiaoxi also relaxed a lot. Looking at the blood marks on the man's arm, she apologized again, "Teacher Shen, I'm really sorry. I really didn't mean to hurt you."

I heard that an artist’s appearance is his capital, and gold is precious!

She, a poor student, cannot afford to pay.

"They said it's okay, don't take it to heart." Shen Heng chuckled and made a harmless joke, "But it seems you should trim your nails."

Han Xiaoxi was stunned and raised herself. No, the original owner's little paws looked familiar, and she herself felt the same.

The little finger on the right hand is slightly longer, which is a habit common to art students. It is convenient for supporting lines when drawing or sketching.

It is estimated that this nail accidentally injured the actor.

What a sin!

Shen Heng looked at the silly movements of the little girl in front of him, and the curve of his lips widened, "You have a good rest and don't worry about me, or treat me as if I don't exist."

Han Xiaoxi nodded hurriedly, this person really didn’t have the slightest bit of style and was very easy to get along with.

With the handsome guy in front of her, she boldly asked, "Teacher Shen, can I take a photo with you?"

There was a group photo taken once in his previous life. It was a group photo with all the employees when he visited the subsidiary where she worked.

He is in the C position, and she is in the corner.

"Of course." Shen Heng put down his overlapping long legs, with a slight smile on his lips, not the slightest bit impatient, "Are you coming over or should I come over?"

"I'll come over here, just sit down!" Han Xiaoxi was excited for a moment, lifted the quilt and got out of bed, and also grabbed the mobile phone on the bed.

When she saw the small mobile phone in her hand, she suddenly remembered that this mobile phone had no camera.

I couldn’t take a photo at all…

"Um...Teacher Shen, let's forget it." She blushed in embarrassment.

"It's okay, come here and use my mobile phone." The man leaned to the side of the sofa in a gentlemanly manner and gave up most of his seat to her.

He also took out the high-end flip business phone from his pocket.

Han Xiaoxi nodded her head, ran over quickly with her slippers in hand, and sat down next to the man in a somewhat reserved manner.

Seeing the appearance of the two of them on the screen of the man's mobile phone, Han Xiaoxi was stunned.
